description: The verified numbers behind progrss plates, one per row: country or group, indicator, unit, period, value, claim type (Fact / Estimate / Forecast), and the original publisher, report, edition and link. Search by keywords (e.g. "Nigeria population", "cobalt", "USGS") and/or a plate number. Every number was read on the primary publisher's own page; cite the publisher and the plate.

plate.description: Optional plate number, e.g. "037", to get all its numbers.

query.description: Keywords: a country (name or ISO code), an indicator, a publisher. Every keyword must match.

name: get_numbers
title: Get the sourced numbers
